rows.title: The germinal products overview page, with units and packages commodity totals
rows.detail: A trader filling in a germinal products notification needs an overview of their own notification, so they can see its reference and status, what is left to do and where to go next. The germinal products set gets its own overview page, keyed by the notification as the live animals overview is, with the same heading, status strip, numbered task list and end buttons. Germinal products are counted by quantity in units or pieces and by packages rather than by head of animal, so 'Your commodities' shows a 'Units/pieces' card then the 'Packages/boxes' card, and no animals card and no weight card. Screen-reader users get the same named regions as on the live animals overview, with the cards named for what they count. The live animals overview keeps the cards it shows today.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification has an overview page of its own in the germinal products set, keyed by that notification as the live animals overview is, showing the heading 'Overview', the notification's status and reference, the 'Notification task list' heading with its numbered sections, and the buttons 'Review and submit' then 'Return to dashboard'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-008, -p1-009, -p1-011, -p1-012, -p1-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-001; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p4-001; c-128)

A germinal products notification's overview has the browser page title 'Overview - Import notification service - GOV.UK'. (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p4-001; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-001)

On a germinal products notification's overview, 'Your commodities' shows exactly two cards, in this order: a card labelled 'Units/pieces' with the caption 'Total quantity in this consignment', then a card labelled 'Packages/boxes' with the caption 'Total number of packages in this consignment'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-115, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-115-m1, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-119; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-056; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023; c-244)

With two germinal commodity lines holding quantities 12 and 8 and numbers of packages 3 and 1, the 'Units/pieces' card reads '20' and the 'Packages/boxes' card reads '4'. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-056; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-116, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-117)

On a germinal products notification's overview, both cards read '0' before any commodity line has a quantity or a number of packages. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-116, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-117)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Units/pieces' card is a region named 'Quantity summary' and the 'Packages/boxes' card is a region named 'Packages summary'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-115, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-117; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-008; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-044)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Your commodities' block, the task list and each numbered task section are regions named by their own heading. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-115; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-008)
A live animals notification's overview shows exactly two cards: 'Animals' then 'Packages/boxes'. (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p4-008)

A germinal products notification's overview has no serious or critical WCAG 2.2 A or AA accessibility violations, both with the totals at zero and with quantities and packages entered. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-001)
notes: Combines three thin slices of the one germinal overview page: the page itself (req-1836), its cards (req-788) and its named regions (req-1837). Building them apart would copy the same page three times and repeat the same set-up, review and ladder.

c-244 ruled by precedence: the germinal overview shows the 'Units/pieces' and 'Packages/boxes' cards and no weight card. The kilograms card (req-789) is now out of scope, so the existing row's kilograms card, its rounding rule and its 'Gross weight summary' region come out. The 9 October ruling still decides how the gross weight is stored.
c-128 ruled by precedence: each set keeps a per-notification overview in its own path shape, and the prototype's session-scoped hub address is set aside, so no criterion names a path.

The 'Units/pieces' total reads each germinal commodity line's quantity in units or pieces, which the germinal commodity details page collects; that field is the commodities area's to build in the same theme. The existing row also holds the commodities area's Commodity details completeness rule (req-1763); the combiner keeps that criterion beside these.
The live animals criterion is a regression check on a page this row does not change. The page is copied from the live animals overview after the overview-and-review theme has changed it.

rows.title: The germinal products overview's Addresses section and its single Consignment addresses task
rows.detail: The germinal products set holds no county parish holding number and no permanent address, so its overview's Addresses section has one task, 'Consignment addresses', with the same hint as the live animals overview, and that task is complete once the consignment addresses are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification's overview, the fifth section heading reads '5. Addresses' and that section holds one task, titled 'Consignment addresses'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-121; ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-012; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-053; c-405)

The 'Consignment addresses' task on a germinal products notification's overview shows the hint 'Consignor or Exporter, Consignee, Importer and Place of Destination' under its link. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-035-m1; ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-016)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Consignment addresses' task reads 'Complete' once all five consignment addresses are given, and 'To do' while any of them is missing. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-121; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, -p1-018; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-053)
notes: Draft of the notification-hub half of the existing row that builds the germinal consignment addresses page and its pickers; the combiner keeps it in that row, since the overview task reads the page that row builds.

c-405 ruled by precedence: the owner's 17 November decision fixes the section and task wording as '5. Addresses' and 'Consignment addresses'. The task covers the consignment addresses only, because the germinal set has no county parish holding number or permanent address page.

rows.title: The germinal products overview's Transit countries task
rows.detail: A germinal products notification travelling by road or rail must name its transit countries, so its overview shows a 'Transit countries' task between 'Arrival details' and 'Transport details' whenever transit countries are required, complete once at least one is selected. When they are required comes from the arrival and transit rule the germinal set shares with live animals.
acceptanceCriteria: When transit countries are required for a germinal products notification, as for a road or rail journey, its overview's '3. Transport and arrival' section lists 'Arrival details', then 'Transit countries', then 'Transport details'; for an air or sea journey it lists 'Arrival details', then 'Transport details'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-060; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-019; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

Where it is shown, a germinal products notification's 'Transit countries' task reads 'To do' until at least one transit country is selected, and 'Complete' once one is. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-030; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)
notes: Draft of the notification-hub half of the existing row that builds the rest of the germinal journey, including its transit countries page; the combiner keeps it in that row, since the task reads the page that row builds.
The rule that decides when transit countries are required belongs to the arrival-and-transit area; this task shows only when that rule says so.
